items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Baby Dodge was in St. Louis. He sends for Baby Dodge... Joe jumps up and sends for Baby Dodge... He asked Joe, he said, who gave you permission to send for this man?

ctx.x: And he could execute on a mellophone as fast as John Dots could on his clarinet. And he played an alto sax too. Well, we was playing there and Jimmy Pilar was playing violin and doubling on his beat tenor, you know, tenor saxophone, Nora on trombone, Lil on piano, myself on bass, Joe, and around minor hall. So something come up and he wanted to do away with Jimmy. See, Jimmy Pilar. Yeah. And finally he was going to let Jimmy Pilar go and so minor taking it up.
